# A function a test hands its `Test` asserts through it as the test body does:
# on html the helper is emitted with the page and calls the agent's own
# method, where it used to call a `t.assert` the agent does not have and fail
# every test reaching it with a TypeError, passing or not.

! sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 1 failures'

! sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '--- PASS: /AHelperPasses'
stdout '--- FAIL: /AHelperFails'
! stdout 'is not a function'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component counter ui.node {
    var hits = 0
    ui.button #b(text="{hits}", @click { hits += 1 })
}

func atLeast(t Test, got int, want int) {
    t.assert(got >= want)
}

func testAHelperPasses(t Test, c counter) {
    c.b.click()
    atLeast(t, c.hits, 1)
}

func testAHelperFails(t Test, c counter) {
    atLeast(t, c.hits, 1)
}

ui.window {
    counter
}
-- testrun/html/none/app.sngl/counter/1 --
sha256:746cbe5c70cd4b9d04b3e8a550704579
{
  "results": [
    {
      "Desc": "AHelperFails",
      "Error": "(got \u003e= want)",
      "Failures": [
        {
          "Message": "(got \u003e= want)"
        }
      ],
      "Log": [
        "(got \u003e= want)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "Desc": "AHelperPasses",
      "Passed": true
    }
  ]
}
